name: NH Investment & Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: NH Investment & Securities Co., Ltd. is a multifaceted financial institution that provides services across wealth management, investment banking, proprietary trading, and equity sales, serving clients both within South Korea and globally. The firm offers a wide array of financial instruments and asset management services, encompassing equities, diverse fund options, and structured products like ELS/DLS. It also delivers expert corporate finance solutions, specializing in debt and equity capital market activities, and facilitates digital sales. Furthermore, the company actively invests in, trades, and distributes a range of assets, including stocks, bonds, and FICC (Fixed Income, Currencies, and Commodities) derivative products. Established in 1969, the company is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It was previously known as Woori Investment & Securities Co., Ltd., adopting its current name, NH Investment & Securities Co., Ltd., in December 2014. The entity operates as a subsidiary of NongHyup Financial Group Inc.
